meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先用 smart_search 搜索代码结构，再用 smart_outline 查看文件骨架，最后用 smart_unfold 展开具体函数，代替直接读取整个文件。
howto.when: 当你想了解代码结构、查找函数或高效浏览代码库时触发。

say.text: 搜索项目中所有与 shutdown 相关的函数。
展开 worker-service.ts 中的 shutdown 方法。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude uses smart_search to discover code symbols, smart_outline to get file structure, and smart_unfold to expand specific functions, replacing full file reads.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

say_en.text: Search for all functions related to shutdown in the project.
say_en.note: Claude will call smart_search and return ranked symbols with file overviews.

say_en.text: Unfold the shutdown method in worker-service.ts.
say_en.note: Claude will call smart_unfold to show the full source of that function.
